# Tsumugu-wiki Directory Schema — Final Spec (v1, adopt-ready)

**Schema name:** Atoms + Source-Bundles + Meta, Bound by a Frontmatter Contract.
**Status:** Adopt. This supersedes the flat `content/zh-Hant/` dump.

Two decisions resolve every judge objection up front, because the live config (`markdownLinkResolution: "shortest"`, confirmed at `quartz.config.ts:70`) makes them load-bearing:

- **D1 — No bare role-name links, ever.** Atoms link by CJK term (`[[夜市]]`, unique per language, resolves under "shortest"). Every non-atom page (`summary`, `vocab`, `index`, lesson) is linked path-qualified with an alias (`[[zh-Hant/sources/videos/why-friendship-differs/vocab|深入詞彙]]`). The generator owns all links; humans rarely hand-author them. This kills the `summary.md`/`vocab.md` collision the judges flagged across all four proposals.
- **D2 — Atoms own etymology; bundle `vocab.md` is a thin gloss that transcludes/links atoms, never re-explains them.** This is enforced by linter (see §4), not left to discipline. It closes the "two homes for vocab" leak that every judge named as the central risk.

---

## 2. Naming conventions

**FOLDERS** — lowercase, kebab-case, semantic, stable.
- **Top axis = language code** (`zh-Hant`, `vi`), BCP-47-ish, matches existing on-disk root.
- **Second axis = the three trees** plus shared assets: `words/`, `encoding/`, `sources/`, `audio/`.
- **Source folders = kebab-case slug** derived from title/URL: `why-friendship-differs`, `steam-controller-review`, `2025-top-ten-gadgets`, `gsm1`, `gsm2`. The slug is the single stable join key referenced by every atom's `source:`/`sources:` field and by every bundle page's `source:`.

**FILES** — two regimes, chosen by `type`:
- **Atoms are named by their CJK term, verbatim:** `words/夜市.md`, `words/熱鬧.md`, `encoding/熱鬧.md`. The filename *is* the term — no transliteration. Quartz handles Unicode; `[[夜市]]` resolves directly under "shortest". The encoding twin reuses the identical filename in `encoding/`, so word↔encoding is a mechanical 1:1 map: `encoding/{term}.md` exists iff `words/{term}.md` has `encoding: true`. **Disambiguation rule for the CJK-filename invariant** (the escape hatch the judges said was unspecified):
  - Canonical path is `words/{NFC(term)}.md`. The generator normalizes to Unicode **NFC** before writing or existence-checking.
  - A term containing `/`, whitespace, or other filesystem-hostile characters (rare for single words/idioms) is rejected by the linter and filed with an explicit `slug:` override in frontmatter; the filename then uses that slug and the page carries `term:` for display.
  - Homographs/polyphones that need separate pages take a parenthetical pinyin disambiguator: `行(xíng).md` vs `行(háng).md`, both with explicit `term: 行` + distinct `reading:`. Default is one page per written form; split only when senses genuinely diverge.
- **Everything else is kebab-case English/role slugs.** Inside a source bundle the role is the filename — `index.md` / `summary.md` / `vocab.md` — the folder already carries the source identity. (`why-friendship-differs-summary.md` becomes `.../why-friendship-differs/summary.md`.)
- **Course lessons keep the existing pattern:** `lesson-NN-vocab.md` (zero-padded `NN`). Gaps are allowed (gsm2 is missing 5/10/15/17/20).
- **Pedagogy pages are theme slugs, role-suffixed:** `tone-correction-patterns.md`, `common-learner-errors-summary.md`.
- **Q&A transcript files = `{year}-{month}-{video_id}.md`** (e.g. `2026-04-14360402.md`), matching `qa_pipeline.py`'s `slug()` exactly so synthesis provenance and files share one id space.

**WIKILINK DISPLAY (per D1):**
- Atoms: link by term — `[[夜市]]`, `[[熱鬧]]`.
- English-titled / role pages: path-qualified + alias — `[[zh-Hant/sources/videos/why-friendship-differs/vocab|深入詞彙]]`, `[[zh-Hant/sources/courses/gsm2/lesson-01-vocab|Lesson 1]]`.
- The encoding twin links its atom by term (`[[熱鬧]]`); the atom points at its twin path-qualified (`[[zh-Hant/encoding/熱鬧|encoding deep-dive]]`) to sidestep the words/熱鬧 vs encoding/熱鬧 basename tie under "shortest".

## 3. Frontmatter contract

Three fields are **required on every page** and are what tooling + MOCs key off: `type`, `lang`, and (for non-atoms born of a source) `source`. The generator writes these; the build fails on a missing required field (§4). Reuses existing fields verbatim: `lang`, `type`, `source`, `ci_real`, `tags` (and adds `ci_method`, `status`, `term`, `reading`).

```yaml
# UNIVERSAL (every page)
type: word|encoding|summary|vocab|source|course|pedagogy|transcript|moc
lang: zh-Hant            # vi later; OMIT only on the cross-language meta/ MOC + content/index.md
```

```yaml
# type: word  — global atom  (content/zh-Hant/words/夜市.md)
type: word
lang: zh-Hant
term: 夜市
reading: "ㄧㄝˋ ㄕˋ / yè shì"
pos: noun
status: l2                         # personal known/unknown — baked into PUBLIC build (toggle: §6)
tocfl: A2
first_seen: 2026-06-01
source: why-friendship-differs     # SLUG of bundle first met (single first-seen join key)
sources: [why-friendship-differs, night-market]   # all bundles that introduced it (back-refs)
related: ["小吃", "熱鬧", "市場"]
encoding: true                     # flips true iff encoding/夜市.md twin exists (generator-owned)
tags: [topic/food, topic/city, semantic/place]
```

```yaml
# type: encoding  — atom twin  (content/zh-Hant/encoding/熱鬧.md)
type: encoding
lang: zh-Hant
term: 熱鬧
word: 熱鬧                          # back-link to canonical words/ page; ALWAYS == term (audit key)
reading: "ㄖㄜˋ ㄋㄠˋ / rè nào"
status: l1
tags: [encoding, topic/atmosphere, semantic/sound]
```

```yaml
# type: source  — the bundle's index.md  (.../why-friendship-differs/index.md)
type: source
lang: zh-Hant
slug: why-friendship-differs       # == folder name
kind: video                        # video | course | webclip
title: "外國人與中國人的友誼觀"
english_title: "Why Chinese and Foreigners View Friendship Differently"
source_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2idX7w0gs4k
channel: mandarin-corner
transcript: private                # pointer only; body lives under private/transcripts/zh-Hant/<slug>.md
date_added: 2026-06-06
```

```yaml
# type: summary  (.../why-friendship-differs/summary.md)
type: summary
lang: zh-Hant
source: why-friendship-differs     # must match a sources/ folder name (linter-validated)
title: "外國人與中國人的友誼觀 — 摘要"
english_title: "...— 95%-CI summary"
ci_real: 0.957                     # the measured comprehensible-input score (summary only)
ci_method: vocab-coverage-v1       # how ci_real was computed (reused/standardized field)
tags: [summary, mandarin-corner, friendship, comprehensible-input]
```

```yaml
# type: vocab  (.../why-friendship-differs/vocab.md)  — thin gloss, atoms own etymology (D2)
type: vocab
lang: zh-Hant
source: why-friendship-differs
word_count: 22
atoms: ["隱私", "封閉", "矛盾"]      # the atoms this bundle introduced/promoted (link, don't re-explain)
tags: [vocab, mandarin-corner, friendship]
```

```yaml
# type: course  (.../courses/gsm2/index.md)
type: course
lang: zh-Hant
slug: gsm2
title: "Get Speaking Mandarin Part 2 — Vocabulary"
channel: outlier-linguistics
voice: serena
lessons_present: [1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,11,12,13,14,16,18,19,21,22,23,24]   # gaps explicit, not implied
```

```yaml
# type: vocab (course lesson)  (.../courses/gsm2/lesson-01-vocab.md)
type: vocab
lang: zh-Hant
source: gsm2                       # the course slug is the join key
course: gsm2
lesson: 1
voice: serena
title: "GSM2 Lesson 1 — Vocabulary"
tags: [course/gsm2, vocabulary]
```

```yaml
# type: pedagogy  (content/meta/pedagogy/tone-correction-patterns.md)  — NOTE: no single source
type: pedagogy
lang: en                           # pedagogy is ABOUT Mandarin, WRITTEN in English
target_lang: zh-Hant               # which language the method teaches
title: "Tone correction patterns"
derived_from: [2026-04-14360402, 2026-02-14360404]   # Q&A transcript slugs synthesized
tags: [pedagogy, tones, methodology]
```

```yaml
# type: transcript  (private only)  (content/private/transcripts/...)
type: transcript
lang: zh-Hant                      # or en for the qa/ transcripts
visibility: private
ci_policy: "RAW — never graded; CI is reference metadata only"
source: why-friendship-differs     # or the Q&A slug for qa/ files
```

```yaml
# type: moc  (any index.md the explorer surfaces)
type: moc
lang: zh-Hant                      # omit on meta/index.md and content/index.md
title: "zh-Hant"
tags: [moc]
```

---

## 4. MOC / index.md / tag taxonomy — navigation + anti-duplication

**Folders own structure, so every folder gets an `index.md` (`type: moc`) the Quartz explorer surfaces.** Quartz v4 has no Dataview, so any "generated" MOC below is produced by a **wiki-repo build emitter** (not the data-free engine repo) — a small script run before/within `npx quartz build`. Where the emitter hasn't shipped, the MOC is hand-curated and the linter (below) is the safety net.

- `content/index.md` — language switchboard + link to `meta/`.
- `{lang}/index.md` — language MOC: counts (atoms, encoding, sources), latest additions, links to the four sub-MOCs.
- `{lang}/words/index.md` — **the ATOM index, generated:** A–Z by zhuyin, by-TOCFL, by-status. This is the findability backbone for "do we already have a page for X?" — and the same query the generator runs (`exists words/{NFC(term)}.md`?) before creating any atom.
- `{lang}/encoding/index.md` — only actively-memorized words.
- `{lang}/sources/index.md` (+ `videos/`, `courses/`, `clips/` sub-MOCs) — the **source catalog**: one row per reading with `ci_real`, `word_count`, `date_added`, grouped by kind. (Judges across proposals called this the single highest-value findability artifact — adopted.)
- `meta/index.md` + `meta/pedagogy/index.md` — the method hub; pedagogy MOC cross-tabs themes ↔ contributing Q&A session slugs.

**Anti-duplication is enforced by a build-time linter (CI gate), the highest-leverage adopt regardless of IA:**
1. Every page has `type` + `lang` (+ `source` where the type requires it). Missing → build fails.
2. `source:` on any bundle/atom must resolve to a real `sources/**/` folder name. Dangling slug → fail.
3. **One-atom-per-term:** no two files resolve to the same `NFC(term)` within a language. Duplicate → fail. (Catches a re-ingested `熱闹`/`热闹` variant before it lands.)
4. **Encoding twin invariant:** `encoding/{t}.md` exists ⟺ `words/{t}.md` has `encoding: true` and `word == term`. Drift → fail.
5. **D2 dedup guard:** a `vocab.md` body may not contain a `## Character breakdown` / `## Etymology` section for any term that has a `words/` atom; it must link the atom instead. Violation → fail.
6. No public `type` under `private/`; no broken wikilinks.

**TAGS carry every axis NOT promoted to a folder**, namespaced so they stay machine-parseable:
- `topic/*` (`topic/food`, `topic/city`, `topic/atmosphere`) — semantic domain.
- `semantic/*` (`semantic/place`, `semantic/sound`) — finer sense grouping.
- `channel/*` or bare channel slug (`mandarin-corner`, `outlier-linguistics`) — source provenance facet.
- pedagogy axes: `tones`, `shadowing`, `methodology`, `learner-errors`.
- structural-role tags mirroring `type` (`summary`, `vocab`, `encoding`) for tag-page browsing.

**Rule of thumb:** if it's an axis tooling must *traverse* (language, type, source) → **folder**; if it's a facet a human *browses* (topic, register, channel, method theme) → **tag**. Keeps the tree shallow and discovery rich.

---

## 5. Where Q&A pedagogy lives — DECIDED

**`content/meta/pedagogy/`, a top-level tree OUTSIDE every language root.** The 34 syntheses live here, not under `zh-Hant/`, for reasons the live data makes concrete:

1. **Cross-source, now provably cross-course.** The worklist holds **34 sessions: 26 from gsm1 + 8 from gsm2.** A synthesis like "tone-correction-patterns" is distilled from many of them across *both* courses, so it has no single `source` slug to file under any bundle; frontmatter uses `derived_from: [<qa-slugs>]`.
2. **Different `type` and authorship language.** Pedagogy is `type: pedagogy`, `lang: en`, `target_lang: zh-Hant`. Filing English method essays under `zh-Hant/` (a Traditional-Chinese reading tree) would lie about both axes and pollute the word/source MOCs and the word graph.
3. **About method, future-proof across languages.** Tone/shadowing/error/study-method notes are a meta layer over the whole project; when `vi/` arrives, much pedagogy generalizes, so a language-neutral home is correct now.

Pedagogy pages cross-link **down** into atoms when a point is concrete ("learners confuse `[[熱鬧]]` with `[[鬧鐘]]`"), but are never reachable as children of a language or source. The **raw Q&A recordings/transcripts are private speech** and live in `private/transcripts/qa/`; only the distilled English syntheses are public.

(Truly language-specific pedagogy that won't generalize can later take a `target_lang`-scoped subfolder — `meta/pedagogy/zh-Hant/` — but that is deferred until a second language exists; do not pre-split.)

---

## 6. Multilingual + public/private

**`zh-Hant` → `vi` generalizes by cloning the language root verbatim:** `vi/{index.md, words/, encoding/, sources/, audio/}`. One generator parameterized by `lang` writes both. The **Hán-Việt bridge is a frontmatter edge, not structure:** a vi atom carries `han_viet: 熱鬧` (or a `bridge:` list) pointing at its zh-Hant counterpart, surfaced via `vi/_bridge/han-viet.md` (a single generated edge table) and cross-namespace wikilinks. No refactor when vi lands; the bridge is additive.

**Public/private is a folder boundary, not a per-file flag** — the leak-proof design that already matches reality:
- `private/` is excluded by **both** `ignorePatterns: ["private", ...]` (Quartz, confirmed `quartz.config.ts:18`) and `.gitignore: private/` (confirmed). Belt and suspenders; both already in place, no config change needed.
- Transcripts (native readings + 34 raw Q&A) live only under `private/transcripts/`. Public pages reference them by *pointer* (`transcript: private` in the bundle `index.md`), never by body.
- **`status:` (per-word known/unknown) IS baked into the public build** (per memory: vocab status is publishable). To keep the engine repo data-free and give a clean escape hatch, the bake is governed by a single build-time flag `BAKE_STATUS` (default on for the wiki repo); off produces a status-neutral public artifact. The engine repo never sees status.

---

## 7. Migration plan — ordered, from CURRENT state

Cheap moves = `git mv` + small frontmatter add. Generator changes = code that must ship before the next ingest.

1. **Scaffold the trees** (cheap). Create `zh-Hant/words/`, `zh-Hant/sources/videos/`, `zh-Hant/sources/courses/`, `zh-Hant/sources/clips/`, `zh-Hant/audio/`, `meta/pedagogy/`, `private/transcripts/qa/` — each with an `index.md` (`type: moc`). `zh-Hant/encoding/` already exists.

2. **Move `夜市.md` → `zh-Hant/words/夜市.md`** (cheap move; small edits). Add `type: word`; add `encoding: false` (no `encoding/夜市.md` twin yet); normalize `source:` from the raw JSON path `"examples/zh-hant/night-market.prepared.json"` to the slug `night-market` and add `sources: [night-market]`. **Rewrite its two dangling links** `[[xiaochi-snacks|小吃]]` → `[[小吃]]` and `[[renao-lively|熱鬧]]` → `[[熱鬧]]` (this is the link-regime fix the judges flagged as understated — count it as real work, not a free move).

3. **Fix the encoding twin + create its missing atom** (cheap). `encoding/熱鬧.md` already has `type: encoding`; add `word: 熱鬧`. Create the canonical `zh-Hant/words/熱鬧.md` (the dictionary atom it deepens) with `encoding: true`, so the 1:1 invariant holds. Create `zh-Hant/words/小吃.md` and `zh-Hant/words/市場.md` so the now-bare `[[小吃]]`/`[[市場]]` links resolve.

4. **Convert the friendship pair into a bundle** (move + rewrite). `mkdir zh-Hant/sources/videos/why-friendship-differs/`; `git mv why-friendship-differs-summary.md → summary.md` and `why-friendship-differs-vocab.md → vocab.md`; add `index.md` (`type: source`) carrying the YouTube URL + `channel: mandarin-corner` + `transcript: private`. **Rewrite the inter-page link** `[[why-friendship-differs-vocab|…]]` → path-qualified `[[zh-Hant/sources/videos/why-friendship-differs/vocab|深入詞彙]]`. Normalize `source:` from the full URL to the slug `why-friendship-differs` (keep the URL as `source_url` on `index.md`). **Promote `隱私`/`封閉`/`矛盾`** out of `vocab.md`'s prose into `words/` atoms; reduce `vocab.md` to a thin gloss that links them (enforces D2).

5. **Move GSM2 into the course bundle** (cheap wholesale move). `git mv zh-Hant/gsm2/ → zh-Hant/sources/courses/gsm2/`. The `audio/` pool moves **with** the folder unchanged, so all 512 `![[audio/<hash>.mp3]]` embeds keep resolving (do NOT split audio per-lesson — that would break every embed for no dedup gain; the 512 hashes are all unique). Add `type: vocab` + `course: gsm2` + `lesson: NN` to each lesson; add `type: course` to `index.md` with the real `lessons_present` list (19 present; gaps 5,10,15,17,20). Repoint `index.md`'s `[[lesson-NN-vocab|…]]` links to the new path-qualified form. Scaffold `courses/gsm1/` identically when its 24 lessons land.

6. **Place the 4 YouTube source pairs + GSM1.** `why-friendship-differs` is migrated in step 4. The other three named videos (`steam-controller-review`, `life-as-open-world-rpg`, `2025-top-ten-gadgets`) are net-new ingests — the generator writes them straight into `sources/videos/{slug}/{index,summary,vocab}.md`. GSM1 (24 lessons) lands in `sources/courses/gsm1/` via the same generator path. No back-migration needed for these.

7. **Stand up `meta/pedagogy/`** (generator change). Generate the first syntheses from the 34 Q&A sessions — `tone-correction-patterns.md`, `shadowing-method.md`, `common-learner-errors-summary.md`, `study-methodology-spaced-repetition.md` — with `type: pedagogy`, `lang: en`, `target_lang: zh-Hant`, `derived_from: [<qa-slugs>]`. Copy the raw transcripts from `/Users/n1/Projects/tsumugu/personal/sources/gsm-qa/transcripts/*.txt` into `private/transcripts/qa/{slug}.md` (filenames already match `qa_pipeline.py`'s `{year}-{month}-{video_id}` slug).

8. **Backfill the contract + repoint the generator** (generator change, highest leverage). Ship the linter (§4) and run it once over all ~26 existing files so every page has `type`+`lang`(+`source`); fail the build on any miss. Point the generator at the canonical paths — `words/{NFC(term)}.md`, `encoding/{term}.md`, `sources/{kind}/{slug}/{role}.md`, `meta/pedagogy/{theme}.md` — and at the D1 link emitter (bare-CJK for atoms, path-qualified+alias for everything else) so all future pages file themselves correctly with zero human filing.

9. **`private/` is already correct** (cheap). Mirror future course/Q&A transcripts under `private/transcripts/{lang}/{slug}.md` and `private/transcripts/qa/{slug}.md`. No `ignorePatterns`/`.gitignore` change — both already exclude `private`.

**Net:** small corpus, but migration is *touch-most-files*, not pure `git mv` — the load-bearing real work is (a) the slug→term link rewrite in `夜市.md`, (b) the friendship pair rewrite + atom promotion, (c) GSM2 frontmatter backfill across 19+1 files, and (d) standing up the linter + generator path/link changes that make the contract enforced rather than aspirational.

## 8. Open questions (need Wedge's call)

1. **Build emitter vs. hand-MOC.** The generated atom index (by-zhuyin/TOCFL/status) and the sources catalog table need a custom emitter in the **wiki repo** build (Quartz v4 has no Dataview). Build it now, or hand-curate MOCs until the corpus justifies it? This is the one piece of net-new tooling the schema leans on.
2. **`status:` in the public build.** Confirmed publishable per memory, gated behind `BAKE_STATUS` (default on). Keep it always-on, or do you want the flag actually wired so you can ship a status-neutral build on demand?
3. **Atom promotion threshold.** Should *every* word in a bundle `vocab.md` become a `words/` atom (maximally compounding, larger flat tree), or only words you flag/memorize (leaner, but the bundle gloss does more explaining and risks brushing against the D2 dedup guard)? This sets how fast `words/` grows toward the thousands-scale where sub-bucketing matters.
4. **`words/` sub-bucketing trigger.** A flat `words/` is fine now; at hundreds→thousands the explorer degrades. Pre-commit to a generator-driven bucket rule (e.g. `words/{zhuyin-initial}/{term}.md`) from day one to avoid a mass re-path later, or defer and accept a future migration?
5. **GSM2 lesson gaps.** Lessons 5/10/15/17/20 are absent (Q&A-only sessions, or genuinely missing vocab?). Backfill them, or is `lessons_present` the permanent record?
6. **Pedagogy granularity.** Four theme syntheses for 34 sessions, or also keep thin per-session provenance stubs under `meta/pedagogy/sessions/`? The decided spec keeps provenance in `derived_from:` + private transcripts only; per-session public stubs are an opt-in extra.
